text: Close your eyes. For the next few minutes, your only job is to see what you want as if it is already yours.
Take a slow breath in... and let it go. With each breath, let your body soften and sink down.
One more deep breath in. And out. Feel yourself dropping into a calm, focused state.
Step inside the picture. Feel it on your skin, hear the sounds around you. Notice how good it feels to be here.
This is yours. Feel the gratitude of already having it. Say silently to yourself: this is who I am.
Hold that feeling. Slowly begin to return. When you are ready, open your eyes, and carry it with you.
